input.quote: 9. TRUELINK WARRANTIES. TrueLink represents and warrants that the Interface and all related software (i) is designed to be used before, on and after January l, 2000;
input.rationale: Section 9 is TrueLink's only warranty to us and is limited to Year 2000 date processing; there is no warranty that the Hosting/Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner, no conformance-to-documentation warranty for the Interface or software, no compliance-with-laws or malicious-code warranty, and no repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy. By contrast, Section 8 imposes compliance, content and malicious-code warranties on Client, and the disclaimer at p0076 (which is prefaced "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT") leaves us with almost nothing to rely on. We therefore insert the playbook performance warranty and remedy into Section 9; the disclaimer already carves out express warranties, so no change is needed there.

proposal.summary: Add a TrueLink performance warranty (professional and workmanlike services, 12-month software conformance, legal compliance, no malicious code) with a repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 currently gives us only a Year 2000 warranty, so we have added the standard performance warranty package - professional and workmanlike services, 12-month conformance of the Interface and software to its documentation, compliance with laws and no malicious code - together with a real repair, replacement, re-performance or refund remedy. If TrueLink prefers, we can fall back to a 90-day software conformance period with the same remedies.

ops.text: TrueLink further represents and warrants that (a) the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (b) for a period of twelve (12) months following delivery, the Interface and all related software will conform in all material respects to its documentation and will be free of viruses, worms, Trojan horses and any other malicious code; and (c) TrueLink will comply in all material respects with all laws applicable to its performance under this Agreement. Client's remedy for breach of the warranties in this clause is, at TrueLink's option, re-performance, repair or replacement, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming services, Interface or software.
